verdict.rationale: The full source is publicly hosted on GitHub. Users can clone and build it from source (gh-16, community member compiled it in comm-13), and it accepts contributor PRs (gh-14), so the source is clearly readable. However, nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the license terms (e.g. a LICENSE file or license name), independent confirmation of open-source licensing.
